five_second.sells: online courses in meditative pattern drawing, sacred geometry, and 'manifesting' art
five_second.for_whom: reads like it's aimed at wellness-curious adults into self-help, not casual young creatives

features_used.moment: Tapped the Sacred Geometry card hoping for more of the pretty spiral pattern art, but it dropped me on a business-coaching-flavored 'Power of Spirals' sales page with testimonials from an entrepreneur and an HR specialist.
Tapped the card that actually matched my TikTok and got sent to a completely differently-branded page, 'Tangle With Ann', taught by someone named Ann Diane Tai instead of Anna Denning.
Tapped the 'Pay in US dollars' link just to see the price and landed straight on a real checkout page with card fields, showing $99 and a big wall of terms-and-conditions text right there.

features_looked_for_but_missing: a free preview or sample pattern I could try before paying
a simple price tag on the course card instead of having to enter checkout to see it
one consistent teacher/brand name across every course page
feature_that_most_helped_the_decision: the colorful hand-drawn spiral and heart pattern artwork on the course card thumbnails - genuinely TikTok-pretty and gave instant visual proof this was real pattern-drawing content
feature_that_most_hurt_the_decision: the $99 price only showing up once I was already on a real checkout page, next to a wall of terms-and-conditions text, and taught by a different-named instructor than the homepage

friction.moment: Sacred Geometry card led to an entrepreneur/HR-testimonial coaching page instead of pattern art content
Pattern Drawing card jumped to a differently-branded 'Tangle With Ann' page with a different named instructor than Anna Denning, making it unclear whose site I was even on
Had to enter an actual card-number checkout page just to learn the price was $99, with a big terms-and-conditions wall right there

delight.moment: The green spiral mandala drawing on the Sacred Geometry card was genuinely pretty, exactly the kind of thing I'd screenshot off TikTok
The colorful heart pattern piece under Art of Manifesting Method looked like real hand-drawn art, not stock photos

what_earned_it: real hand-drawn artwork samples instead of stock photos
matching social icons (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube) linking out consistently
a secure/SSL note on the checkout page
trust.what_it_would_take: keep one consistent name and face across every course page instead of jumping from Anna Denning to Tangle With Ann/Ann Diane Tai, and show a price or a free preview before I'm dropped onto an actual card-number checkout page

brand_recall.tell_a_friend_one_sentence: It's a $99-a-course site for meditative spiral and mandala drawing plus 'manifesting' stuff - pretty pictures, but it felt more like your aunt's wellness hobby than something I'd grab off a TikTok.
